summary: Washington County lookout on Pea Ridge: a 66-foot wood tower built in 1941 by CCC Camp S-78. No source found describes the site today.

events.note: 8.91 acres acquired for a fire tower

New roof laid on the tower residence, fiscal 1972-73

notes_for_editor: Two dedications: the 1941 bulletin and Tribune give October 26, 1941, but a Tribune item of November 1, 1946 calls a 'new' tower dedicated. The Forest Lookouts 1969-70 note says the tower was one of the original wooden towers erected in the 1930s, which conflicts with the 1941 entries. No source found says what stands at the site today; the record status should stay unknown. Leads not used because fetch_text returned only page titles: a Missouri Conservation History Facebook post (says the tower 'was located near Sullivan') and a Waymarking listing called Kelleter Tower Stone, which may mark the site. Ed Christopher's 38 years is undated. Record height_m 20.1 matches 66 feet.
